description: Preferred runway modes, owner-supplied 24-10-2026, in priority order (order in this file is the tie-break): equal first 28AD and 10AD; then equal 16AD and 34AD. 28AD and 10AD have a 28 kt crosswind limit (owner, 24-10-2026); 16AD and 34AD have no crosswind limit of their own and fall back to the pack default. No capacity has been supplied for any mode.
